newsitem.title: USA: High Point, N.C., advances $71.5 mln bond proposal.
newsitem.headline: High Point, N.C., advances $71.5 mln bond proposal.

text.p: North Carolina's High Point City Council agreed to send a proposal for a $71.5 million bond referendum to state officials for approval, the Greensboro News & Record said Friday.
The bond issue would be the biggest in the city's history and must be approved by the state's Local Government Commission before it can go on the May 6 ballot.
The bonds would fund eight projects, including street repairs, new parks and an indoor swimming pool.
City officials said growth in the property tax base would enable them to service the debt without a major increase in the tax rate.
High Point's last bond referendum was in May 1993, when voters approved a $43 million package.
